The slides of this part set out what the five analysts of the robustness study of SCORE (Multi100; Aczel et al. 2026) did with the claim, and present two tools for saying which question an analysis answers, the estimand statement and the causal graph. When the slides ask for your estimand statement, write it in the chat, hold it, and send it when the facilitator says go.

## Task 2 – The data, the estimand and the graph

**In your workspace**, in the two boxes of Task 2 of `index.qmd`. Count what came back for each name, complete the estimand statement, and put the questions of the second box to the causal graph of `R/dag_starter.R`.
